title: I2 — Apply engine, Terraform retired
essence: I2 — Apply engine, Terraform retired — 18 work items delivered against 64 acceptance criteria, 2 merge-boundary gates run. 15 of 18 captured checkpoints changed behaviour. Command output compared after normalising: tap-duration, duration, iso-timestamp, worktree path. API bodies compared as JSON after dropping volatile JSON keys (ids, timestamps, urls, etags, sizes, watchers) and declared ignoreKeys.

narrative: A platform team can now declare their GitHub org — settings, teams, repos, rulesets — in YAML and apply it through the GitHub App API with a single `gw apply` command. Terraform and its state files are gone. The plan engine diffs declaration against live org or a fixture (no credentials needed on PRs), apply resets then converges the org idempotently, and reset scrubs all prefixed resources back to safe defaults. Every verb is wired end-to-end; CI runs the full suite green.
